high_level_description: The image depicts a series of red, jellyfish-shaped light pillars captured over the Tibetan Plateau. The photograph is credited to Angel An and Shuchang Dong, as indicated by the text below the image. The image itself shows multiple bright red lights extending upwards from the ground, resembling the tentacles of jellyfish, against a dark sky with a reddish hue. The setting appears to be at night or during twilight hours, given the darkness surrounding the light pillars.
